description: Get company fundamentals for a Korean or global stock ($0.05 USDC). Returns market cap, PER, PBR, ROE, EPS, dividend yield, business overview, latest stock price with 52-week range, and most recent quarterly financials (revenue, operating profit, net income).

exchange.description: Exchange code. Default: KRX (Korea). For US stocks: NASDAQ or NYSE

ticker.description: Stock ticker. Korean stocks: 6-digit KRX code (e.g. 005930 Samsung, 000660 SK Hynix, 035420 NAVER, 005380 Hyundai). US stocks: symbol (e.g. AAPL)

name: get_company
